notes.title: Gameplay Video Playlist Released!
notes.notes:
[p]A playlist of gameplay videos for [i]Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-[/i] is now available on YouTube.
I hope it will help you get a feel for the atmosphere of the game.[/p][p]This playlist will be updated as more videos are found.[/p][p]In addition, we have also made available images that can be used for thumbnails and other purposes.
Please feel free to use them if you stream or create related content.[/p][p][/p][p]■ Gameplay Video Playlist URL[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLK3_FKqhoKXdpJiAZgEYlY5lb8XhMm8va&si=9LTYn4zINNXFFl-S"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]■ Thumbnail, Logo, and Other Image Resources[/p][p][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ccLrsLgiZQFogmKebHiLb0LafoNttZmm?usp=drive_link"]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ccLrsLgiZQFogmKebHiLb0LafoNttZmm?usp=drive_link[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Announcement of Release Date and Recruitment of Early Access Applicants
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][b]Regarding the Release Date of [i]Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-[/i][/b][/p][p]We are pleased to announce that the release date has been set for [b]September 10, 2025[/b].[/p][p]In line with this, we are now recruiting streamers who would like to take part in [b]early access streaming[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]● Eligibility[/b][/p][list][*][p]Able to livestream on YouTube [b]before September 10[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Have [b]50 or more channel subscribers[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Have [b]at least 2 past livestreams[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Willing to [b]keep the archive available[/b] (in principle)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]● How to Apply[/b]
Please send us a DM via the official Imagawa Soft X account:
[/p][p][url="https://x.com/ImagawaSoft"]https://x.com/ImagawaSoft[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We are also releasing a [b]thumbnail template[/b] (just add a character image and it’s ready to use) as well as [b]materials to help you create your own[/b].
These include game and character assets you can freely arrange to create professional-looking visuals.[/p][p][b]Streamer Resource Folder:[/b]
[/p][p][url="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ccLrsLgiZQFogmKebHiLb0LafoNttZmm?usp=sharing"]https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ccLrsLgiZQFogmKebHiLb0LafoNttZmm?usp=sharing[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][i]Notes:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Example usage included[/p][/*][*][p]Applications may be declined based on certain criteria[/p][/*][*][p]Limited availability[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]If you want, I can also make a [b]shorter, social-media-friendly version[/b] that fits platform character limits while keeping the main points. Would you like me to prepare that next?[/p]

notes.title: Announcement: Demo Release
notes.notes:
April 12, 2025

We have released the demo version of "Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-".

In this demo, you can play Stage 1 (Standard difficulty only) with all three available characters.
We hope you enjoy experiencing the game firsthand!
